newsitem.title: UK: RMC continues lower on German concens.
newsitem.headline: RMC continues lower on German concens.

text.p: Shares in UK building materials concern RMC Group, down for the last three sessions, fell further on Friday to a 22-month low amid continued concerns that weakness in the German economy will undermine profits, dealers said.

Shares in RMC shed 31p by 1143 GMT to 908-1/2p. Others in the building materials sector, especially those firms heavily exposed to Germany, also tumbled. Redland fell 10p to 255-1/2, the lowest price since November 1995.
Shares in both RMC and Redland slumped yesterday after a report showed a rise in German unemployment and a decline in GDP growth.
"It's just more of the same worries," said one market maker.
The shares have also been hit hard by the recent strength of the sterling, yet the currency's retreat on the foreign exchange market today failed to temper losses in the shares.
